kind: bounded scalar analysis/probing host diagnostic; no mobile or energy acceptance claim
candidate: validity-aware bounded analysis and adaptive scalar probing, identified by source hashes
methodology: Identical release probe source. Four allocator-disabled processes/version in ABBA order twice; warmup plus five samples per case, and separate allocation builds. Fixtures, schema/numeric checks and output destruction excluded from timing. Each filter includes its complete cold validation and any index/expression construction. Calculator/statistics/histogram use 16/32/48 cubed points with two scalar fields; histogram has 64 bins. Probe uses 8/16/24 cubed source grids and 1 (near/far), 8, 32 or 64 queries. Small queries use an allocation-free linear cell walk; larger batches build the compact BVH. Resample uses 4/6/8 cubed sources to inclusive 5/7/9 cubed targets with two scalar fields. The all-valid timed fixtures have equivalent support/numeric work; median changes intentionally from upper middle to arithmetic midpoint for even counts. Separate public regressions cover masks, malformed state, extreme/subnormal values, parser bounds and probe selection priority. Baseline statistics/histogram omit dataset validation; candidate includes it. Shared host without affinity, thermal control, aggregate CPU-time, peak RSS, energy or physical-device qualification. Do not infer whole-frame or universal performance acceptance.

rejected_cutoff8_diagnostic.note: Previous ABBA run used a cutoff of eight queries. Candidate library source hashes differ from the final version only in probe.rs (LINEAR_QUERIES changed from 8 to 64). These records guided removal of the 32-query regression; they are historical diagnostics, not final acceptance data.
